title: Shipping - Cost, Payment Terms and Conditions (TERMS)
description: Comprehensive guide to shipping methods, costs, and payment terms including FOB, CFR, CIF, and other Incoterms with their definitions and seller responsibilities.

rows: Seller pays the costs necessary to bring the goods to named port of destination
Same as CFR but in addition the seller includes marine insurance loss or damage to goods during shipment
Same as CPT, but in addition the seller includes insurance loss of or damage to the goods during carriage
Seller pays freight to named destination
Seller clears the goods for export at named destination - but before the customs
Seller deliver the goods at named destination - pays charges of delivering the goods to be cleared at custom
Seller deliver the goods at named destination
Seller deliver the goods on board the ship, uncleared for import at named destination - seller pays to bring the goods to named destination
Seller deliver the goods at named destination - cleared for importation
Seller makes the goods available at his premises
Seller sends the goods to alongside the vessel - or in the named port of shipment
Seller hands over the goods cleared for export to the charge of the carrier named by the buyer at named place
Seller clears the goods for export at named port of shipment
